# Dracula + LYT

Dracula + LYT combines a Dracula-inspired dark theme with the LYT Mode layout. It renders Dracula-style syntax highlighting and blog-style headings for a clean, content-first presentation.

![Dracula + LYT screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xryul/ObsidianMD_Dracula_x_LYT/HEAD/Overview.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Dracula + LYT"
    author: "xryul"
    repo:   "xryul/ObsidianMD_Dracula_x_LYT"
    slug:   "dracula-lyt"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/dracula-lyt"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/xryul/ObsidianMD_Dracula_x_LYT"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xryul/ObsidianMD_Dracula_x_LYT/HEAD/Overview.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Dracula-inspired dark theme blended with LYT Mode layout to give Obsidian notes a cohesive, readable look. Render Dracula-style syntax highlighting and blog-style headings for clean, content-first presentation."
}
```
